{{Quote|Fascinating! The local fauna are mutating rapidly, and I believe the lightning-spire could be the cause&hellip;|The researcher|<ref name="Encounter 1" />}}
A '''researcher''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] individual who worked for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="Encounter 1" /> Around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{DynamicDate|Spire Consequences|Dromund Kaas}}</ref> the researcher was stationed in the wilderness outside [[Kaas City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], where the researcher led a study of unusual mutations observed in local wildlife. The researcher noted that fauna in the area had begun to mutate rapidly and believed it was caused by long-term exposure to [[lightning spire]]s,<ref name="Encounter 1" /> tall devices used by the Sith Empire to divert and harness the frequent lightning strikes on Dromund Kaas.<ref name="Lightning Spires">{{TORcite|type=codex|Lightning Spires}}</ref>

To investigate further, the researcher requested assistance in collecting biological samples from the affected wildlife. These samples were later used for analysis of the creatures' altered behavior.<ref name="Encounter 1" /> During the research, the camp was attacked by electrically-charged beasts. As the creatures moved toward the equipment, the researcher called for help to defend the camp so the analysis could be finished.<ref name="Encounter 2">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=dynamic|Shocking Developments|[[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial researcher appears in the dynamic encounter mission "Spire Consequences"<ref name="Encounter 1" /> and "Shocking Developments"<ref name="Encounter 2" /> introduced in Game Update 7.7: ''Dynamic Worlds'', released on [[May 28]], [[2025]], as part of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'',<ref name="Dynamic Worlds">{{TORweb|url=info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20250528-1|text=Game Update 7.7 "Dynamic Worlds" is now live!}}</ref> the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Announcement">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210701|text=Announcing Legacy of the Sith, the next expansion for Star Wars: The Old Republic}}</ref>
